All in one haus

Five worlds, one floor

The café is just the beginning. Behind it sits a full creative haus — studio, event space, floral atelier and monthly classes.

Café

Coffee, matcha and brunch plates, open every day of the week.

Studio

Styled sets refreshed monthly — hire by the hour for shoots and content.

Event Hall

Intimate celebrations fully styled around your theme and guest list.

Florals

Fresh arrangements and installs from our in-haus floral atelier.

Classes

Floristry, baking and content workshops hosted every month.

The studio

A new dream set, every month

Our studio is restyled monthly — draped ceilings, vintage arch doors, pottery and textures you won't find in any other Nairobi studio. Walk in, plug in, create.

  • Hourly hire for photographers & creators
  • Fresh themed set every month
  • Props, florals & styling included
  • Coffee from the café while you shoot

Three steps to your day
